method: Checked archived source existence and SHA-256 for every available non-bulk claim evidence reference.
Resolved official JSON pointers against archived response bytes and compared the serialized evidence values.
Verified each available registry and annual-account record belongs to its requested organization number.
Required the exact-entity website gate for every available company-site evidence reference.
Reparsed archived HTML to verify observed outbound/contact links and locally dated article-card titles.
scope_limits: Frozen bulk discovery evidence is excluded from per-response archive checks; the run report records the complete bulk snapshot hash.
This is provenance and extraction validation, not an independent competition score or completeness assessment.
No source was fetched again during this audit.
